sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2.  The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent No.2 i.e. District Magistrate, Varanasi to decide the objection of the petitioner dated 22.03.2024 wherein the petitioner has prayed for award of compensation to him as per provisions of the new Act i.e the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
3. It appears that some part of land of the petitioner is proposed to be taken over by the respondents on basis of mutual consent for expanding the runway of Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport,
District Varanasi.

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Hari Shankar vs State Of Up And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. The case of the petitioner is that the amount being offered to him is not adequate and he is claiming compensation as per the provisions of the Act.
5.

Since the acquisition is on basis of mutual consent and, therefore, in case, the offer of the respondents is not acceptable to the petitioner, it is open to him not to accept the same but this Court in exercise of writ jurisdiction cannot compel the respondents to enhance compensation nor any forum is prescribed for determining the right amount of compensation in such cases.
6. Subject to the aforesaid observations, the petition is disposed of.
